title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square, nearest the camera on the left. A raised orange disc labelled Goal sits on the top-right square, farthest from the camera on the right. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow on the token pointing toward a move that brings it one step closer to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Each move goes one square up, down, left or right. The shortest route takes 4 moves: 2 right and 2 up, in any order.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves the token away from the camera's starting view (toward the goal row); the hint arrow stays until your next move. Moves that would leave the board are not counted.
